answer: Bond every identity to a small mutual-stake mesa: at registration each agent locks a bond shared with a handful of randomly assigned strangers, and one member's fraud slashes the whole mesa. Like an orchard where one blighted tree poisons the row, honest agents vet their partners and refuse clones, while a sybil farm must post a fresh bond for every clone, and strangers will not bond with copies they cannot trust, so the Nth clone costs a full new bond plus the trust of strangers across a canyon of verification it cannot fake.
